names.en: G-source characters withdrawn from CJK D

title: G-source characters proposed for withdrawal from the CJK D candidate
scope: The 3,215 G-source characters that IRGN1531 asks to withdraw from the CJK D candidate, one record per row: the D V20 working number and the G source printed beside a glyph cut from the document's page. The numbers are proposal identifiers, and no published Unicode scalar is claimed for any row. The request leaves later resubmission open.

documents.title: Request of withdrawing 3,215 G-source CJK_D characters
documents.status: Asks IRG#31 to withdraw 3,215 G-source characters from CJK D because the evidence for them could not be collected in time. Pages 2–26 print six columns of glyphs, each beside a D V20 working number and a G source; the document itself prints only the draft number “IRG N xxxx”. A withdrawal request states no scalar for any row and is not a final disposition.
